title: Short-Term Rental Allocations
description:
Community Count for Short Term Rentals in Sandy City
This map contains a polygon layer of the Sandy City Communities. With attributes of the allocated short term rental space. This layer holds the per-community short-term-rental permit cap, not the location of individual rentals. Each of the 30 community areas carries `Max_STR` (the cap), `Current_STR` (permits issued) and `Open_STR` (permits still available). One community is at -1, meaning it is over its cap. 30 multipolygon features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: Alloted_Status
table:columns.description: Open. Coded value. The source layer's domain allows: `Available STRs`, `FULL: Next application will be waitlisted.`, `Waitlist has been placed.`. Codes: `Open` = Available STRs, `Full` = FULL: Next application will be waitlisted., `Wait` = Waitlist has been placed..

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: COMMUNITY_ID
table:columns.description: Sandy community area number, joining to the `communities` collection. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 30 rows, 30 distinct values, ranging 1 to 30.

table:columns.name: COMMUNITY_NAME
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 30 rows, 30 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Max_STR
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 30 rows, 15 distinct values, ranging 2 to 23.

table:columns.name: Current_STR
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 30 rows, 13 distinct values, ranging 0 to 14.

table:columns.name: Open_STR
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 30 rows, 15 distinct values, ranging -1 to 16.

table:columns.name: Shape__Area
table:columns.description: Polygon area computed by the geodatabase, in the square units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it, because it is not updated when a shape is edited.

table:columns.name: Shape__Length
table:columns.description: Line length or polygon perimeter computed by the geodatabase, in the units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
